reason: The cited evidence strongly supports the spray-coating feasibility, tribocatalytic self-lubrication, and low friction/wear performance of the 2D HEA on steel, but provides no evidence for solid-solution hardening as a mechanism, nor for the annealing process or its effect on adhesion and bulk microstructure of TC4.
premises: 2D HEA (MoWNbTaV)0.2S2 nanoflakes can be spray-deposited as a thin film.
The coating provides solid-solution hardening and impedes dislocation movement.
Under high contact stress, the coating exhibits tribocatalytic activity forming a lubricious tribolayer.
The coating achieves low friction (COF ~0.076) and wear rate under ~0.9 GPa contact pressure.
Low-temperature annealing can ensure coating adhesion without altering TC4 bulk microstructure.
